title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — if peccare ≠ imputari, explain other mode you always deny
pass_a_gloss: If you retreat and say 'to sin' here does not mean 'to have sin imputed,' then all sinned by the actual act in some other mode—which you must name, having always denied any mode but imputation.
pass_b_english: You will perhaps say that that to sin does not signify sin to be imputed. From this I will infer, therefore all sinned by actual sin, not because it is imputed to them, but in another way, which I desire to be explained to me by you, who so often deny that Adam's actual sin is ours in any other way than by imputation.
source_text: Dices fortasse istud peccare non significare peccatum imputari. Hinc inferam, igitur peccasse omnes peccato actuali, non quia ipsis imputetur, sed alio modo, quem mihi a te explicari cupio, qui toties negas peccatum actuale Adami nostrum esse alio modo quam per imputationem.

lemmas.gloss: to sin not meaning to be imputed
